posts.text:
Trump routinely accuses his political opponents of treason. We in the democratic opposition don't do this. But if you ask who comes closer to fitting the designation, this from John Harington seems apt:
“Treason doth never prosper: what ’s the reason?
Why, if it prosper, none dare call it treason.”
